name: Dynamic DNS
description: Give this workspace a stable public name that follows your home internet connection. Turn it on and <slug>.workspace.ddns.tekflox.com points at your current external IP, updating on its own whenever your provider changes it — so a phone, a SIP handset or anything else outside the house can keep reaching you at one name. Off by default: nothing is published until you switch it on, and switching it off removes the name again. If your connection is behind carrier-grade NAT it tells you so instead of publishing an address that could never answer.
